messages.content: Selamat malam. Saya Ahmad, NOC engineer shift malam ni untuk TM Unifi region Selangor. Ada satu alarm baru sampai dari EMS Huawei untuk gNodeB di site Shah Alam — site `SA-gNB-0421`, technology 5G. Severity major, probable cause 'Cell Down'. Boleh tolong ingest dulu, lepas tu validate normalization sebab kebelakangan ni saya nampak severity selalu salah-translate dari Huawei punya level.

Selamat malam Encik Ahmad, terima kasih kerana menghubungi sokongan assurance. Saya akan ingest alarm raw tersebut dan terus jalankan validation normalization dalam profil `vendor_strict` untuk Huawei. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.arguments: {"ingestion_source": "ems", "received_at": "2026-05-21T22:14:18+08:00", "raw_payload": {"headers": {"source": "huawei-ems-prod-02", "content_type": "application/xml"}, "body": {"alarm_name": "CELL_DOWN", "perceived_severity": "3-Major", "managed_object": "gNodeB=SA-gNB-0421,Cell=12", "event_time": "2026-05-21T22:13:51+08:00", "additional_info": "S1 link lost; cell out of service"}, "raw_text": "<Alarm><Name>CELL_DOWN</Name><Severity>3-Major</Severity><MO>gNodeB=SA-gNB-0421,Cell=12</MO></Alarm>"}, "signature": {"source_system": "huawei-ems-prod-02", "original_alarm_id": "HWEMS-44218-7732", "probable_cause": "Cell Down", "specific_problem": "S1 link lost; cell out of service", "severity": "major"}, "network_element": {"vendor": "Huawei", "technology": "5G", "ne_type": "gNodeB", "ne_id": "SA-gNB-0421", "location": {"site_id": "site-SA-0421", "region": "Selangor", "city": "Shah Alam"}}, "lifecycle_event": "raise", "ingestion_options": {"deduplication": {"strategy": "signature_hash", "time_window_seconds": 300}, "enrichment": {"load_inventory_context": true, "load_service_impact": true}, "validation_mode": "shadow"}}

Alarm telah di-ingest, Encik:

- **Alarm ID:** `alm-SA-5g-99214`
- **Severity normalised:** `major`
- **Category:** `hardware`
- **KPI terjejas:** `cell_availability`, `rrc_connection_success_rate`
- **Service impact:** anggaran ~1,840 subscriber terjejas (1 cell down)
- **Adjacent sites:** `site-SA-0419`, `site-SA-0420`

Sekarang saya akan jalankan validation normalization dalam profil `vendor_strict` dengan expected severity `major` dan category `hardware`. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

messages.name: validate_alarm_normalization
messages.content: {"alarm_id": "alm-SA-5g-99214", "validation_profile": "vendor_strict", "overall_quality_score": 0.91, "rule_outcomes": [{"rule_id": "vs-sev-mapping-huawei", "status": "pass", "observed": "major", "expected": "major"}, {"rule_id": "vs-category-cell-down", "status": "pass", "observed": "hardware", "expected": "hardware"}, {"rule_id": "vs-kpi-mapping", "status": "pass", "observed": ["cell_availability", "rrc_connection_success_rate"]}, {"rule_id": "vs-alarm-class-consistency", "status": "warn", "observed": "availability", "expected": "availability", "notes": "alarm_class agrees but vendor extension field `huawei_subclass` missing"}, {"rule_id": "vs-location-completeness", "status": "pass"}], "discrepancies": [{"field": "vendor_extensions.huawei_subclass", "issue": "missing", "severity": "low"}]}

Validation normalization selesai, Encik:

- **Skor kualiti keseluruhan:** **0.91 / 1.00** (lulus)
- 4 rule lulus penuh, 1 rule `warn` sahaja

**Pecahan rule:**
| Rule | Status | Catatan |
|---|---|---|
| `vs-sev-mapping-huawei` | pass | severity major dipetakan dengan betul dari `3-Major` |
| `vs-category-cell-down` | pass | category `hardware` |
| `vs-kpi-mapping` | pass | KPI tepat |
| `vs-alarm-class-consistency` | **warn** | medan `huawei_subclass` hilang |
| `vs-location-completeness` | pass | site/region lengkap |

Masalah severity mistranslation yang Encik risau **tidak berlaku kali ini** — pemetaan Huawei `3-Major` ke `major` betul. Hanya isu `huawei_subclass` hilang (severity rendah), tidak menjejaskan operasi.

Langkah seterusnya: saya boleh jalankan correlation untuk lihat sama ada ada alarm berkaitan dari cell/transmission lain di kawasan Shah Alam. Setuju?

Yes please correlate, kira topology_neighbor scope, max 2 hops, time window 15 minit before sampai now. Severity major dan critical je. Then bagi saya correlation details — saya nak tahu service impact dengan member alarms.
Baik Encik. Saya akan correlate dahulu, kemudian tarik butiran correlation. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

Berikut butiran correlation `corr-SA-22147`, Encik:

**Root cause:** `alm-SA-tx-99211` — **Transmission link OC-3 down pada backhaul ring R-SA-07** (Nokia, NE `R-SA-07-NodeB`, severity critical, raised 22:12:08).

**Member alarms (4 total)**
| Alarm | Severity | NE | Diraise |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alm-SA-tx-99211` (root) | critical | R-SA-07-NodeB | 22:12:08 |
| `alm-SA-5g-99214` | major | SA-gNB-0421 | 22:13:51 |
| `alm-SA-5g-99216` | major | SA-gNB-0419 | 22:14:02 |
| `alm-SA-5g-99219` | major | SA-gNB-0420 | 22:14:31 |

**Topology:** ketiga-tiga gNodeB tergantung pada ring backhaul R-SA-07 melalui POP Shah Alam Central.

**Service impact (gabungan)**
- Cell terjejas: **5**
- Subscriber dianggar: **~6,420**
- Servis terjejas: 5G data, VoNR
- Severity class: **high**

Ini klasik cascade — alarm gNodeB yang Encik laporkan adalah simptom, bukan punca. Saya cadangkan kita trigger playbook auto-remediation `pb-transmission-ring-failover` ke atas correlation group (sasarkan ring R-SA-07), dalam mod `manual_approval` dahulu memandangkan impact tinggi. Setuju?

Setuju. Trigger playbook tu, target correlation, execution mode manual_approval, max impact scope single_site, dengan rollback on alarm increase threshold 3. Lepas tu bagi saya remediation status include logs supaya saya boleh forward ke shift lead.
Baik Encik. Saya akan trigger playbook untuk correlation group dan terus periksa status. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

Sila forward kepada shift lead Encik. Apabila dia approve, playbook akan terus jalankan step 3-5 secara automatik dengan guardrail rollback (kalau >3 alarm baru muncul, sistem akan rollback). Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang saya boleh bantu, Encik?

One more thing. Saya nak set up QA validation session untuk kumpul ground truth — correlation `corr-SA-22147` tu betul-betul true_positive dengan root cause `alm-SA-tx-99211`. Owner saya, reviewer juga saya. Tag session 'shah-alam-night-shift-20260521'. Lepas tu bagi saya quality metrics dari session ni — precision, recall dan automation success rate.
Baik Encik. Saya akan mulakan sesi validation dengan ground truth yang Encik berikan, kemudian terus tarik quality metrics untuk sesi tersebut. Mohon tunggu sebentar.
